conditions: A product is in the catalogue
User clicks 'Add to cart' on a product detail page
items.expected: A confirmation message is displayed; the cart icon in the header shows the number of items added

conditions: User adds a first product to the cart
User navigates to a second product and clicks 'Add to cart' again
items.expected: Cart confirmation is shown for the second product; the cart icon count increments to reflect the total number of items

conditions: Cart has at least one line item
User changes the quantity of a line item (increases it)
items.expected: The quantity field is updated; the line total and cart total reflect the new quantity

conditions: Cart has at least one line item
User clicks the remove button for that line
items.expected: The remove action is confirmed by the line disappearing; the cart total updates to exclude the removed line

conditions: Cart page is open with at least one item
items.expected: No axe-core WCAG A/AA violations on the cart page

excluded.reason: Admin product search — unrelated to shopper cart; touches admin UI not covered by TOOL-12
Billing address at checkout — belongs to TOOL-16 checkout flow, not TOOL-12 cart management
Both open bugs (TOOL-21, TOOL-20) are Active but do not touch this story's behaviour; no confirmation tests are warranted here
TOOL-12 covers cart add/update/remove for a shopper; no authentication, session, or data-protection behaviour is introduced by these ACs
